title: Sustained Yap/Taz activation promotes aberrant alveolar epithelial cell differentiation and drives persistent fibrotic remodeling [Multi-omics]
overall_design: Cultured CD326+ epithelial cells from wild-type and Yap/Taz active (driven by Stk3/4 deletion in Sftpc+ AT2 cells) with Tomato lineage trace. After Passage 1, cells were flow sorted for Tomato+ to isalate only lineage traced cells. Cells were then cultured an additional 10 days in SFFFM media then either continued in SFFFM or switched to alveolar differentiation media (ADM) for 7 days. Cells were then bulk RNA sequenced.
type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
Genome binding/occupancy profiling by high throughput sequencing

title: Wild type, saline, RNA
treatment_protocol_ch1: Mice were given 3mg/mouse of tamoxifen, 3 weeks later they were injured with 0.08iU bleomycin or saline, then mice were sacrificed 4-weeks after bleomycin injury.
growth_protocol_ch1: Primary cells directly after mouse sacrifice.
extract_protocol_ch1: Lungs were excised, incubated in DNAse, Disapse and collagenase in a C-Tube and single cells were generated using an octomacs. Cell suspensions were passed through 100um then 40um filter.
10X multiome protocol-10x Genomics Chromium sequencing targeting 10,000 nuclei per sample and 50,000 reads per nuclei
description: Wild type, saline, RNA gene expression
data_processing: SoupX and scDoublet were used to remove ambient DNA and detect doublets
Seurat/Signac used for Multi-resolution clustering, normalization and dimension reduction
Harmony was used to map the scATAC-seq data onto these clusters by identifying open chromatin regions associated with specific marker genes and integrated with the scRNA-Seq
MACS2 was used for peak calling with 2kbp of transcriptional start site
Promoter associated TF factor enrichment was assessed using Chromvar
Assembly: GRcm39 reference genome
Supplementary files format and content: h5 files
